ordinarySteps: Seal original vault with PIN and enable Connections, External connectors and Remote support model through Features controls.
Open BYO AI; select stability_sd3; configure an operator-approved HTTPS endpoint, model and API key and verification prompt.
Test AI connection; require real inference response completion. Save AI connection; require a second completed inference and persisted encrypted credentials.
Cold navigate and unlock the same vault with its original PIN; saved key field remains empty and the sealed token remains present.
Fill Image prompt, press Generate image, require real Image.decode on the generated blob and exact original downloaded PNG bytes/SHA.
Capture the entire document with saved shared configuration and added Image generation region; no DOM overlays or cropping.
functionalAddedCapture.protocol: POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/sd3 with documented multipart prompt/model/mode/aspect_ratio/output_format, bearer credential and application/json response. Owned fixture returns a real PNG encoded in the documented response; endpoint must permit the actual PWA origin.
functionalAddedCapture.source: Actual matching final browser receipt/result/capture hashes and bounded ordinary workflow are recorded in paired-build-proof.json. Canonical configuration capture alone does not recreate the owned protocol fixture or added workspace.
